summary: The review found that persistence is centralized for HTTP, A2UI, and audio, but Telegram and MS Teams still call FormValidator directly. The main unresolved risks are the trace contract, canonical versioning/capping, effective-model extraction, and the missing authenticated submission-audit read path.

suggestions.title: Route all committed channels through SubmissionPipeline
suggestions.rationale: HTTP and audio use SubmissionPipeline, but Telegram and MS Teams directly invoke FormValidator and therefore cannot inherit a persisted ValidationResult trace. Successful submissions from those adapters need a shared pipeline integration, or the scope must explicitly exclude their non-persisting callback flows.

suggestions.title: Define a separate deterministic-trace configuration model
suggestions.rationale: FormSchema currently has an LLMValidationConfig for plausibility only; no configuration expresses summary/full/off or a trace byte cap. Add a typed FormSchema block with an explicit default and keep it separate from LLMValidationConfig so disabling LLM checks cannot accidentally disable deterministic auditing.

suggestions.title: Make ValidationResult the sole trace handoff
suggestions.rationale: ValidationResult currently contains only validity, errors, sanitized data, and extras, while SubmissionPipeline independently constructs the stored context. Add an optional typed trace to ValidationResult and have submit persist exactly that result; pass the collector only as an optional keyword to validate_field, including its recursive voice-envelope call, preserving existing callers and the list[str] return contract.

suggestions.title: Use stable check identifiers rather than helper names or error text
suggestions.rationale: The validator has early returns for remote/REST fields, required checks, relation shape, coercion, constraints, type checks, options, cross-field callbacks, and async callbacks. A trace based on function names or error strings will miss checks and cannot reconstruct arbitrary callable metadata; define stable IDs and explicit skipped/pass/fail semantics for each named check, including dynamic validator references.

suggestions.title: Version both the schema fingerprint and validator ruleset
suggestions.rationale: FormSubmission stores form_version, but the version is an author-controlled string and does not identify changes in validator code. Persist form_version, the canonical validation-subset sha256, and a separately versioned trace/ruleset format; otherwise an auditor cannot distinguish a schema change from a validator implementation change.

suggestions.title: Centralize canonical fingerprint generation with validation traversal
suggestions.rationale: The validator uses its own _collect_fields traversal and deliberately excludes ARRAY item templates from top-level validation, while FormSchema.iter_fields_recursive includes them. A separately implemented fingerprint can hash rules that did not run or omit rules that did; create one canonical serializer that explicitly matches the audited validation scope, preserves meaningful order, and hashes deterministic JSON.

suggestions.title: Cap the serialized trace deterministically before persistence
suggestions.rationale: FormSubmissionStorage currently JSON-serializes context without a size limit, and the pipeline merges arbitrary context with llm_validation. Enforce the cap on UTF-8 serialized validation JSON before that merge, reserve space for header and truncation metadata, use deterministic field/check ordering, and record omitted counts so truncation is unambiguous.

suggestions.title: Resolve effective LLM identity from the response object
suggestions.rationale: AnswerPlausibilityChecker currently writes config.model into PlausibilityReport and _parse ignores response metadata. AIMessage already exposes model, provider, and CompletionUsage; add resolved_model/provider/usage without changing report.model, and treat an ok response lacking a non-empty effective model as an LLM failure routed through on_error rather than persisting an unidentified success.

suggestions.title: Add a dedicated authenticated submission-audit read contract
suggestions.rationale: FormSubmissionStorage already provides get_submission(submission_id, tenant=...), but routes register no submission read endpoint; existing public form routes include validation and submission writes. Add a non-public tenant-scoped endpoint that returns only the audit projection and enforces a dedicated permission before lookup, avoiding exposure of answers or constraints to public clients.

suggestions.title: Do not rely on current RBAC shadow checks for audit authorization
suggestions.rationale: The current handler gate is shadow-mode by default, and RBACContext.has_permission checks only a codename; it does not evaluate the submission resource, form ownership, tenant, or own/team/client scope. The audit read must use an enforcing authorization path with a resource containing submission_id/form_uid and must fail closed when RBAC resolution is unavailable.

suggestions.title: Add contract tests for trace completeness and cross-channel parity
suggestions.rationale: Existing tests cover pipeline persistence and HTTP plausibility context, but do not pin deterministic trace contents, truncation, resolved model identity, or direct Telegram/MS Teams bypasses. Test every early-return branch, hidden/relaxed required resolution, summary/full/off modes, byte-cap markers, generic/tabular/document persistence, missing-model failure, and authenticated allow/deny reads.
